leadText: Ryota Iwasaki (Japanese: 岩崎諒太 Iwasaki Ryōta) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Ryota Iwasaki (Japanese: 岩崎諒太 Iwasaki Ryōta) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Iwasaki was born sometime on July 1 in , . He started working on during , mainly voicing minor characters. Iwasaki's most notable roles so far are Mr. Electric and Gladion's Zoroark. He is currently affiliated with the talent agency Atomic Monkey.
